column7: Builds the agent registry and agent-auth state from config before serving, resolving each agent's secret; a mistake would admit or refuse the wrong agents (moved from Gateway::run, MIK-8416)

Installs the single minting strategy and the per-backend account strategies before serving; a mistake would mint for a passthrough backend or dispatch a managed binding without custody (moved from Gateway::run, MIK-8416)
Declares multi-user status, which arms the per-user OAuth isolation guard; a mistake would serve one user's gateway-held token to another (moved from Gateway::run, MIK-8416)
Refuses to start on start_refusal before any listener opens; a mistake would serve a configuration that must not serve (moved from Gateway::run, MIK-8416)
